calls.title: Tom Ross and Graham McNicoll
calls.summary: GrowthBook is a flexible, warehouse-native experimentation platform that serves over 2,700 companies, emphasizing self-hosting and SQL transparency. It integrates with existing data warehouses, appealing to enterprises with mature infrastructures while supporting complex experimentation beyond traditional A/B tests. The platform's unique CDN-based approach enhances user experience by preventing flickering, and its pricing tiers cater to various customer sizes, from startups to large enterprises. GrowthBook is also exploring strategic partnerships to expand reach and facilitate implementation, alongside offering straightforward setup for teams with developer resources. Its experiments have shown significant impacts, with potential improvements of up to 30% in key metrics, thus aiding data-driven product decisions.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, experimentation platform, feature flagging, warehouse-native analytics, agency partnership, AB testing
